Welcome to Atollon, General Dodonna.''"
"''Thank you, Commander Sato. This day has been a long time coming. Hopefully we can finally deal a blow to the Empire and show the rest of the galaxy what we're capable of.|Commander Jun Sato welcomes General Jan Dodonna, aboard the ''Vanguard'', to Atollon|}} The '''''Vanguard''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] commanded by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] that was a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]]. Dodonna took the ''Vanguard'' and several other [[Starship|ships]] that were a part of his [[Massassi Group|unit]] to the [[planet]] [[Atollon]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[2 BBY]], [[Chopper Base|home]] to the [[Phoenix Cell]] Rebel unit. Dodonna's forces and Phoenix [[Squadron]], led by [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]], planned to attack an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Armory Complex|factory]] on [[Lothal]], however the location of Phoenix Squadron's base was discovered by the Imperial [[Grand Admiral|grand admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], who brought his [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]] to Atollon in an effort to crush the Rebellion. The ''Vanguard'' was destroyed in the ensuing [[Battle of Atollon|battle]], though Dodonna and several members of the ship's crew managed to escape shortly before its destruction. ==Description== [[File:Vanguard_bridge.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Vanguard''{{'s}} bridge]] The ''Vanguard'' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. Like all Nebulon-B [[frigate]]s, the ''Vanguard'' was armed with twelve [[turbolaser]]s and twelve [[laser cannon]]s, with the main turbolaser and laser [[cannon]] located at the low-end of the [[Starship|ship's]] bow. The frigate was also equipped with at least eight [[escape pod]]s, powerful dual [[tractor beam]]s, and a primary [[communications array]] located on the port side of the top of the ''Vanguard''. Various portions of the frigate's outer hull were painted [[Color|red]] and yellow. The ''Vanguard''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was placed in the middle of its bow, containing several [[computer]]s and chairs which the frigate's crew was stationed at, a [[holotable]] in the center of the room, and a few stairs with handrails leading up to a raised area from which ''Vanguard''{{'s}} commander, [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]], would give orders during battle. ==History== One of many EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates manufactured by [[Kuat]] Drive Yards, the ''Vanguard'' and several other Nebulon-B frigates were acquired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and used in their struggle against the [[Galactic Empire]]. At least three, including the ''Vanguard'', were a part the [[Massassi Group]] Rebel unit led by General Jan Dodonna in [[2 BBY]]. [[File:Vanguard-RitR.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Vanguard'' comes under attack.]] Dodonna's Massassi Group and another Rebel unit, [[Phoenix Cell]], made plans to attack an Imperial [[Imperial Armory Complex|factory]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], which was responsible for manufacturing all manner of Imperial vehicles, from [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] to [[walker]]s to the newly-designed{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]]. Finally ready for their assault, the ''Vanguard'' and the rest of Dodonna's ships [[Hyperspace|jumped]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' world [[Atollon]], home to Phoenix [[Squadron]]'s [[Chopper Base|base]]. Phoenix Squadron leader [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]], aboard the Rebel [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|cruiser-carrier]] ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', made contact with the ''Vanguard'' and welcomed Dodonna to the planet. The general thanked him, happy to at long last deliver a significant strike against the Empire. Unbeknownst to the Rebels, the Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] had discovered the Alliance's intention to attack the Lothal factory, and after tracking Dodonna's [[fleet]] movements and the trajectory of a transmission trying to warn the Rebels that Thrawn knew of their planned assault sent by [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], who was one of the Rebellion's "[[Fulcrum]]" operatives, discovered the location of Phoenix Squadron's base. Dodonna, still aboard the ''Vanguard'', conferred with Phoenix Squadron via [[hologram]] and they received Kallus's transmission, which had been cut off before he could tell them what Thrawn knew, however after being told by [[Ryder Azadi]], leader of a [[Lothal resistance group|resistance]] on Lothal, that the Imperial fleet had left the [[Lothal system|system]] Rebel [[captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] correctly deduced that Thrawn knew the location of their base, and moments later his [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] came out of hyperspace over Atollon. The ''Vanguard'' would eventually be destroyed in the battle when Syndulla ordered all forces to retreat back to the surface, with survivors escaping via escape pods. {{Ship-stub}} ==Commanders and crew== During the [[battle of Atollon]] the ''Vanguard'' was commanded by General Jan Dodonna, a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from [[Commenor]]. The frigate's bridge crew during the battle consisted of at least five Rebel [[soldier]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Vanguard'' appeared in the twenty-first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]], "[[Zero Hour]],"{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/zero-hour-episode-guide|text="Zero Hour" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} which aired on [[March 25]], [[2017]], on [[Disney XD]].{{WebCite|url=http://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-zero-hour-part-one/EP018796240077|text=Star Wars Rebels : ''Zero Hour: Part One''|date=2017-02-08|work=[http://tvlistings.zap2it.com Screener]|archivedate=20170326180128}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|upN-7ALj2OU|Star Wars Rebels Season 3 – Mid-Season Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-season-three-mid-season-trailer-official}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/zero-hour-episode-guide|text="Zero Hour" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{Armada|set=Rebellion in the Rim|cardname=''Vanguard''|reprint=1}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Databank|general-dodonna|General Dodonna}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Vanguard |ja=ヴァンガード }} [[Category:EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] [[Category:Massassi Group starships]]
